scope: EXT-F-4089-T01, EXT-F-4090-T01, EXT-F-4092-T01 only; no browser, credential, CRM, Gmail, or network execution

finding.issue: The no-match negative accepts 'a specific safe refusal'. A probe failure or absent login form can therefore satisfy the step without reaching the Vault match lookup. Require a proven top-frame safe login form and status no_matching_login for this negative; record other safe refusals as distinct observations, not a no-match pass.

cases.supported: The credential_item_id number is rejected by the strict action:auto schema before the handler; manual execution uses the focused tab and proves no dispatcher approval. The owned fixture, independent authenticated marker, private Vault staging, and exact-item cleanup are appropriate conditions.

site_id:not-a-uuid is rejected by Zod before the handler. Preview and capture use the one API route family; capture is a remote write requiring the stated unique-domain baseline, exact site, independent readback, and exact-ID cleanup. The manual runner does not establish action-tier permission behavior.

finding.issue: The null-conversation manual request is displayed in Chat only while selectedConversationId is null. An existing selected conversation cannot show its card, and switching after invocation is not a reliable procedure. Make a fresh null-selected Chat state an explicit precondition before manual Run, then confirm the card appears before any send. If absent, let the request time out and mark this path unverified.

cases.supported: Missing body is a real schema negative. The handler creates an email_review request; only the review card calls sendReviewedGmail, whose internal user_confirmed value is not a tool argument. Decline, dismiss, edited send, one-message receipt, owned inbox readback, and immutable-send limitation are correctly separated.

limits: Both verdicts assess the proposed procedure against source only. No runtime result, permission proof, card rendering, external effect, or cleanup was observed.
The proposal correctly keeps all three cases NOT_EXECUTABLE until resource/build receipts and owned fixtures exist; this peer report does not promote inventory status or applicability.
